Our work

Commercial landscape maintenance is not judged by any single project. It is judged by whether the property looks the same in month forty as it did in month one — clean edges, weed-free beds, hedges holding their shape, irrigation running, turf healthy through the summer. GreenTree has been holding that line on South Florida properties since 1984.
